name: bar-chart
title: Bar Chart
author: Almas Kasymzhanov <almaskasymzhanov@gmail.com>
description: Horizontal bars for ranked categories. The ranking shape: sort + top-N with an honest 'Other' aggregate, height derived from the item count, explicit label-column width with a CSS-only truncation policy. Tufte data-ink discipline: one accent, no gridlines, direct value labels by default, negatives first-class growing left of an always-visible zero baseline. Reference line (fixed or mean/median), native PNG/SVG/CSV export, JSON portability. Zero dependencies beyond React. Built to WCAG 2.2 AA: roving tabindex, ARIA graphics roles, screen-reader data table, forced-colors support.
